subject: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
overview: The committee reviewed a proposed ordinance to regulate wildlife feeding in residential areas to prevent public health nuisances. Members voted to refer the draft for legal review and additional staff input regarding feral cat management.

items.title: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a draft ordinance to legal counsel and relevant city departments for review and kept the matter in committee. Vice President Collins introduced the measure to mitigate rodent and pest issues, while the committee discussed specific exceptions for bird feeders, lost pets, and feral cat trap-neuter-return programs.
